subject: Mechanical Engineering
title: Wind Turbines: Harvesting the Breeze
description: Learn Wind Turbines: Harvesting the Breeze in one minute.

hook.text: Wind pushes blades. Blades spin a shaft. The shaft drives a generator.

buildup.text: Blades are airfoils — they generate lift, not just catch wind like sails.

discovery.text: Power rises with the cube of wind speed. Double the wind, eight times the power.

twist.text: No turbine can capture more than 59.3% of wind energy. Betz's law sets the limit.

climax.text: Offshore turbines now exceed 15 MW each — enough for 15,000 homes.

punchline.text: The wind is free. Catching it well is the hard part.

quiz.question: What is the Betz limit?
options: The maximum blade length a turbine can have before breaking
The theoretical maximum of 59.3% of wind energy a turbine can capture
The minimum wind speed needed for a turbine to start
